title: Normalized coefficient-level direct-image comparisons
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism. Use the original pro-etale sites and the independent coefficient universes, rings $R,A,N_n$, normalized right and exact image records, and supplied site models $s_X,s_Y$ of [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models]. Fix a completed structural map $c:R_Y\to f_*R_X$ with $c\, f_*(\pi_{X,n})=\pi_{Y,n}\,c_n$ for every positive quotient, and with the constant-to-completion square commuting. There is a CoefficientComparisonData record C with C.source=s_X, C.target=s_Y and C.structureMap=c. Thus the constant, finite and quotient coefficient squares have sectionwise identity ordinary comparisons, their universal-unit normalized derived comparisons, and the quotient identity, successive-quotient and completed-projection coherence equations. This asserts no direct image on coefficient systems, towers, or inverse limits.

proof.text: Retain the supplied source and target models and completed structural map. Naturality of the constant structural maps gives quotient compatibility at every arrow of the coefficient sequence. Compose ordinary pushforward-composition isomorphisms to obtain the identity-on-sections constant, finite and quotient squares.

Choose total right-derived pushforwards by the proved K-injective totalDerivedData helper. Apply the single-coefficient acyclicity lemma to each source coefficient map. The proved derivedCoefficientComparison helper then identifies the two derived models of the ordinary composite, with exactly the factorization-unit equation required by Square.normalization.

Prove directly that normalized derived squares are natural in transformations of their horizontal exact models: precompose with the derived unit, expand the two normalizations, and use ordinary naturality. The unit is invertible on K-injectives, and every derived object has a K-injective representative, so this detects equality. Paste normalized squares, verify the pasted normalization, and apply this naturality lemma to the supplied identity and composition isomorphisms. Their ordinary equations follow from their sectionwise identity hypotheses. This proves all three coherence fields without a separate cocycle theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientComparisons_exists {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (source : SiteData l E X) (target : SiteData l E Y)
    (c : R l E Y ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj (R l E X))
    (hc : ∀ n, c ≫ (ringPush.{t, u} f).map (projection l E X n) =
      projection l E Y n ≫ finiteStructure l E f n)
    (hconstant : integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E Y ≫ c =
      constantStructure l E f ≫
        (ringPush.{t, u} f).map (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E X)) :
    ∃ D : CoefficientComparisonData l E f,
      D.source = source ∧ D.target = target ∧ D.structureMap = c
